					BAR = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = ROOT } }
					FROM = { OR = { is_core_of = BAR is_claimed_by = BAR } }
				}
				AND = {
					ZAM = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = ROOT } }
					FROM = { OR = { is_core_of = ZAM is_claimed_by = ZAM } }
				}
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			ZAM = { transfer_state = FROM }
			ZAM = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = medium_increase } }
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 0
			modifier = {
				add = 3
				OR = {
					ZAM = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
					ZAM = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
